# SecuritiesToken candidate fixtures

These seventeen **NOT-QUALIFIED** configurations are separate from the immutable
431-profile baseline and the historical qualified 425-profile cohort.

`layouts.json` replaces only the broad width-two membership rule with the exact
selected coupled rule plus the source-fixed zero-only ISSUER admin scalar.
Reversing those edits must restore every original profile value, including
balance, allowance, proxy, beacon, implementation and other metadata guards.
`source-review.json` binds the full capture/compiler/report/transcripts/primary
artifacts from the frozen [Phase A proof](../../../docs/securities-operation-proof.md),
including source gaps and null on-chain creation/deployment evidence.

The exact fixed word is not general role-admin permission or proof of successful
initialization. The reviewed semantics requires both exact roots and the scalar;
no independent boolean path can bypass a missing enumerable operation.

Regenerate with the host-only `prepare_securities_role ORIGINAL_PACKAGE_ROOT
FRESH_OUTPUT` tool. Its fresh output preserves helper/CLI source and failures.
See the [focused contract](../../../docs/securities-coupled-role-candidate.md)
for stage ordering, producer representation decisions and remaining gates.

The [saved replay report](../../../docs/evidence/securities-coupled-role-candidate-20260928.json)
records each profile's initialized observed-holder scope and cold gaps. It
contains no actual role operations. Synthetic source execution and saved balance
parity do not establish current runtime, initializer/client/proxy history,
initial role-set coherence, producer role visibility, global-holder coverage or
replacement-package qualification.
